title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: read-only access to device onboarding with View-Only Device Management
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned read-only access from the currently documented Entra-only device management permissions. The administrative paths and role-group command are supported, and the unknown rollout default and feature-specific licensing are appropriately qualified.
